newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH GOVT APPROVES SALE OF ZETOR TO MOTOKOV UNIT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH GOVT APPROVES SALE OF ZETOR TO MOTOKOV UNIT.

text.p: The Czech government on Wednesday approved the sale of a 34 percent stake in tractor maker Zetor a.s. to the local firm Motokov International, Industry and Trade Minister Karel Kuhnl said.

"It will be a direct sale of Zetor shares to the hands of Motokov International. There is a necessity on Motokov to buy the (remaining) shares (as well) currently held by Konsolidacni Banka," Kuhnl said. Motokov must purchase the remaining shares by 2000, he added.

State-held Konsolidacni, which specialises in recapitalising and restructuring Czech banks and industries, holds the state's 79.4 percent stake in the Brno-based Zetor following the privatisation of the company earlier in the decade.
Individual shareholders have 12.8 percent of Zetor, and investment funds hold 6.8 percent.
